svg.title: Typist — typewriter robot
svg.desc: An olive typewriter robot whose head is the carriage: a black platen roller with knobs at each end, a typed sheet of paper rising above it, and two ribbon spools as the eyes. A tall torso carries a nameplate and a bank of round keys with a space bar; the left arm is the long carriage return lever with a flat paddle, the right a jointed claw, on two legs with olive shoes.
